zh-CN.question: 可以讨论哪些需求？
zh-CN.lead: 库存与扫码、企业官网、知识检索与内容工作流。
zh-CN.answer: 先核对业务流程和现有资料，再选择适合的实施范围。独立或团队分工见各案例。

en.question: What work can we discuss?
en.lead: Inventory, business websites, knowledge retrieval and content workflows.
en.answer: Review your workflow and existing material first, then define the scope. Each case identifies independent and team responsibilities.

zh-CN.question: 如何确定交付与费用？
zh-CN.lead: 先确认范围，再估算工作量。
zh-CN.answer: 功能、数据整理、第三方接入和运行环境影响周期与费用。代码、文档、部署、培训和维护分别确认，不默认打包。

en.question: How are delivery and cost scoped?
en.lead: Define the scope before estimating the work.
en.answer: Features, data preparation, integrations and the runtime affect timing and cost. Confirm code, documentation, deployment, training and maintenance separately.

zh-CN.question: 联系前准备什么？
zh-CN.lead: 现有流程、主要问题和希望改善的结果。
zh-CN.answer: 补充使用人数、已有资料和期望时间，通过下方邮箱、电话或微信讨论范围。

en.question: What should I share first?
en.lead: Your workflow, main problem and desired outcome.
en.answer: Include the number of users, available material and preferred timing. Use the email, phone or WeChat details below to discuss scope.
